data.desc: Atossa Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: ATOS) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing innovative medicines in oncology and other areas of significant unmet need. The Company's lead product candidate, (Z)-endoxifen, is in development across several clinical settings, including potential applications in oncology and rare diseases. Atossa has received FDA Orphan Drug Designation for (Z)-endoxifen for Duchenne muscular dystrophy and Rare Pediatric Disease designations for Duchenne muscular dystrophy and McCune-Albright syndrome. (Z)-endoxifen is not approved for any indication. More information is available at atossatherapeutics.com.
